quote: I promised the commissioner an opening on 1 March. I need to know now whether I can keep that promise.
The state has been waiting two years for a lab like this. A date given in public is a date kept.
I will not open a lab that can't run the full menu. People's treatment depends on these results.
The budget was approved once. Every extra naira has to be explained, and I will not be surprised again.
We inspect when the paperwork is complete, not when you would like us to.
The analysers are stuck in clearance and the naira moved against us. I can only do so much from here.
I can train people only once the equipment is in the building.
People want to know when the lab opens and whether local people will be hired.
